weekly.verdict: Candidates for independent investigation, NOT buy instructions
weekly.method: Rules-based financial screening of the configured US universe, with approximate industry concentration limit; not AI-generated financial advice.
weekly.basis: Finnhub quote and last reported company metrics; excludes fees, FX and NZ tax. Verify before trading.
weekly.note: Broad diversified funds may suit long-term investing; a high score does not prove an undervalued company.

learning.reason: Collecting first genuine 30-day forward outcomes. No model has been validated.

paper_diagnostics.measurement: Top 20% highest rules scores of each matured week, measured against SPY over ~30 days; USD price changes only

limitations: No guaranteed real-time prices or complete market coverage.
Machine learning can influence at most 10% of rankings only after six purged, separated forward tests; no probabilities of gains.
Latest available financial data may be delayed or incomplete; timestamps and quality gates apply.
Reference returns in the log exclude transaction fees, spreads, FX, tax and dividends.

warnings: This scanner is best effort and does not monitor every market or source.
Machine learning rankings remain disabled until sufficient real forward validation exists. No profit forecasts or trade recommendations.
Prices are not NZD and may be delayed or unavailable. NZX prices are not currently supplied.
